map.橡胶拉伸强度计算 使用指南: Rubber Tensile Strength Calculation User Guide
map.橡胶拉伸强度计算器：输入试样宽度、厚度与最大拉力，按截面积求拉伸强度（MPa），: Rubber tensile strength calculator: enter the specimen width, thickness, and maximum force, then derive the tensile strength (MPa) from the cross-section area. Used for rubber mechanical property testing and quality judgment.
map.物性达标判定：按 GB/T 528 哑铃型试片测最大力，工具用宽度×厚度得截面积: Pass/fail on physical properties: measure the maximum force on a GB/T 528 dumbbell specimen, use width × thickness for the cross-section area, then compute tensile strength (MPa) and elongation at break (%) to check against the product standard.
map.配方改进验证：对比补强前后拉伸强度与伸长率，判断炭黑/白炭黑用量是否合理，指导配: Formula improvement validation: compare tensile strength and elongation before and after reinforcement to judge whether the carbon black or silica loading is sensible, guiding formula iteration.
map.等级评估：拉伸 ≥20MPa 且伸长 ≥300% 判「高强度高伸长」，适合动态受: Grade assessment: tensile ≥ 20 MPa with elongation ≥ 300% is rated "high strength, high elongation", suitable for dynamically loaded parts (tire treads, transmission belts); lower values call for adjusting vulcanization or reinforcement.
map.算例：最大力 500N、宽 6mm、厚 2mm、标距 25mm、断裂 125mm: Example: max force 500 N, width 6 mm, thickness 2 mm, gauge length 25 mm, break 125 mm
map.为什么用截面积而不是横截面周长？: Why Cross-Section Area Rather Than Perimeter?
map.拉伸强度定义为最大拉力除以试样最小截面积（宽×厚），单位为 MPa（N/mm²）: Tensile strength is defined as the maximum force divided by the minimum cross-section area of the specimen (width × thickness), in MPa (N/mm²); using the perimeter would underestimate the true stress, and GB/T 528 explicitly specifies the product of width and thickness of the parallel central section of the dumbbell as the effective area.
map.伸长率受标距影响吗？: Does Elongation Depend on Gauge Length?
map.扯断伸长率 = (断裂距 − 初始标距)/初始标距 ×100%，与标距取值有关；: Elongation at break = (break distance − initial gauge length) / initial gauge length × 100%, which depends on the gauge length; standard specimens have a fixed gauge length (25 mm for type I), and results from different gauge lengths are not directly comparable, so test under the same standard.
